sources_used: Generali Group FY20-FY24 Annual Reports + 9M25 results (https://www.generali.com/investors)
_ordering_rationale: Assurance EU : P&C Combined Ratio (KPI maitre P&C), Solvency II (solvabilité), AuM Asset Management, Life Op Profit, Dividend Coverage.

kpis.signal: Discipline souscription P&C, sous 95% malgre cat-nat
kpis.description_fr: Combined Ratio segment Dommages (P&C). Mesure rentabilité technique (sinistres + frais / primes). <100% = profitable. Generali maintient discipline souscription.
kpis.description_en: Property & Casualty Combined Ratio. Technical profitability metric (claims + expenses / premiums). <100% = profitable underwriting.

kpis.signal: Solvabilité solide >200%, marge confortable vs SCR + room dividendes/buybacks
kpis.description_fr: Ratio Solvency II Generali (fonds propres eligibles / SCR). Sécurité réglementaire + capacité distribution. Cible interne 150-200%.
kpis.description_en: Generali Solvency II ratio (own funds / SCR). Regulatory safety + distribution capacity. Internal target 150-200%.

kpis.signal: Acquisition Conning (2024) + collecte nette positive. Cible 1000 Mds € moyen terme.
kpis.description_fr: AuM Generali Investments + Banca Generali + Conning (acquise 2024). Pilier diversification revenus hors assurance pure.
kpis.description_en: Generali Investments + Banca Generali + Conning (acquired 2024) AuM. Revenue diversification pillar beyond pure insurance.

kpis.signal: Mix produits unit-linked + protection en hausse, CSM en croissance
kpis.description_fr: Résultat opérationnel segment Vie. Pilier majoritaire (~55% Op Result groupe), mix unit-linked + protection.
kpis.description_en: Life segment operating result. Majority pillar (~55% group OP), unit-linked + protection mix.

kpis.signal: Croissance soutenue DPS, plan 2024-2026 progression +6%-+8% CAGR cumulé.
kpis.description_fr: Dividende par action ordinaire Generali. Politique distribution progressive 2024-2026 (cible cumul 7-7,5 Mds €).
kpis.description_en: Generali ordinary dividend per share. 2024-2026 progressive distribution policy (€7-7.5B cumulative target).

_notes: Generali FY = calendaire. Sources : Annual Integrated Report FY20-FY24 + 9M25 results.
